title: The depth of a charge hole
claim: For a Z_p charge network on a connected graph (knots at the vertices asking out-flow minus in-flow to equal the charge; distinctions on the edges) with nonzero total charge: (1) a knot on three Boolean distinctions is a hole at its own scope in the complex of partial solutions with rank |E| - 1, so every non-atom knot is one and the plain hole criterion certifies only level 2 on parity, sum-mod-3 and not-all-equal networks; (2) over a ring of characteristic p, and over Z, the affine relaxation refutes the network at the size of a star (3 on cubic graphs); (3) over any field in which p is invertible, the least refuting level is the toggle width tgw(G), whatever the charges: a sweep certificate with integer coefficients refutes at tgw(G) over every ring, and a closed-form Fourier solution exists one level below; (4) on connected cubic graphs with at least 4 vertices the monotone toggle width equals cutwidth + 1. Observed on all 27 connected cubic graphs with 4 to 10 vertices: the toggle width equals the monotone one, so the depth is cutwidth + 1 there.
failure_conditions: A constructed certificate fails substitution: a refutation leaves a variable or a zero constant, a sweep uses a bag larger than the toggle width, or the Fourier solution violates an equation.
A broken certificate (a sweep step removed, the charge sum over the wrong characteristic, the Fourier construction at the toggle width) is accepted.
Disagreement with the exact census DEEP-HOLES-20261020-001A-E001 on its cases.
foundation_claim_scope: How many distinctions linear local reasoning must hold at once to see that a charge network is impossible, over which rings. No claim about Sherali-Adams with nonnegativity, Nullstellensatz degree, native structure or physics.

validation.status: checked: prose proofs; check.py builds and verifies by substitution the hole ranks, the charge-sum refutation, the sweep refutation at the toggle width and the Fourier solution one level below on the 30 census networks, verifies sweep refutations and spot-checks Fourier solutions on all 19 connected cubic graphs with 10 vertices (in full on the one whose line graph's treewidth + 1 is below the toggle width), rejects three broken certificates, and agrees with the census; no human or external review
validation.level: V1 prose proof with mechanized certificate checks on declared instances; no trusted kernel.
validation.novelty: known-overlap-likely for the method (averaging over cycle-space symmetries and characters, as in Grigoriev 2001 and Buss, Grigoriev, Impagliazzo and Pitassi 2001) and for statements 1-2; not found stated: the exact level of the affine relaxation for charge networks over a field of the other characteristic as the toggle width, the monotone toggle width as cutwidth + 1 on cubic graphs, and a small cubic graph where signed reasoning needs one level more than the variable graph's treewidth + 1.
validation.independence: Written by Claude in one session at the repository owner's request on 2026-10-20.
